title: Table A.4: Benchmark nuclide binding energies and $(m_e, \mathfrak{D}_\beta)$ calibration floors ($\mathcal{L}_2\text{--}\mathcal{L}_3$, 80-digit atlas)
html:
Archimedean specialisation. Benchmark nuclide binding energies and propagated (m_e, \mathfrak{D}_\beta) calibration floors (80-digit precision) across Z = 0\ldots 92 (full Z = 0\ldots 118 isotope tables follow in the nuclide registry section below). Historical knot-volume matches ({}^2\mathrm{H} \leftrightarrow 6_2, {}^3\mathrm{H} \leftrightarrow 8_{11}, {}^3\mathrm{He} \leftrightarrow L_{6a4}, and the magic-A {}^4\mathrm{He} 29.9557\;\mathrm{MeV} ansatz) are quarantined from prediction columns as circular; first-principles many-body nuclear binding magnitudes remain open.
